top_reviews.title: Zipper broke first time I wore them
top_reviews.text: The leather was kind of cheap looking but I liked they style and the way they fit so I was planning to keep them. The first time I wore them one zipper split open (and I didn't buy these as tight as I normally do because I was able to get a better price on regular calf vs. slim). Upon further inspection, I saw that the zipper was not sewn closed at the bottom of the boot, so even though I could get the zipper back together it kept splitting open as soon as I walked a few feet. I've been wearing the Tuffrider Belmont dress boots for the last 15+ months as my schooling boots and they've been holding up great, so I either got really lucky with those or really unlucky with this pair of Tuffrider boots.
